rationale: C09 is the strongest plausible template because it concerns the same section 22 cotton-quota regime and uses materially parallel machinery: reciting an earlier cotton proclamation and its amendments, identifying the legal basis for changing the regime, and then expressly terminating one prior proclamation while modifying or preserving the underlying proclamation. The child similarly terminates a particular cotton-quota provision while expressly preserving another modification to the older proclamation. C18 and C23 closely parallel the supplemental-investigation and modification framework under section 22(d), but neither matches the child's combination of cotton-specific subject matter and express termination of one component within a continuing proclamation scheme as closely as C09.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I find that the circumstances requiring the quota established for the said harsh or rough cotton ... no longer exist
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I find and declare that the termination of the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... and the modifications hereinafter indicated ... are necessary
shared_material.explanation: Both make a presidential finding that changed legal or factual circumstances require alteration of an existing cotton import-quota regime.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the provisions ... establishing an import quota ... are hereby terminated
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby terminate the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... and do hereby further modify the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of September 5, 1939
shared_material.explanation: The operative clauses use the same concrete mechanism of expressly terminating an earlier cotton-quota proclamation or component while addressing the continuing underlying regime.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Provided, however, that the modification made ... by deleting therefrom ... shall continue in full force and effect
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby terminate ... and do hereby further modify the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of September 5, 1939
shared_material.explanation: Both carefully distinguish the terminated instrument from portions of the older cotton-quota framework that remain operative or are further modified.
